name: paper-digest
description: Authored via workflow.py author (local-maxxing paper digest for the pi route (thought-master 2026-09-14): read:{key} -> chained critique:{key}; readers write the full digest to .agi/context/local-maxxing/papers/<key>.md because the pi runner persists only 200 chars of a stage return and crosses no other stage boundary. args: {papers:[{key,url,hint}], model?})

stages.label: read
stages.prompt:
You are a research reader for the local-maxxing town (goal:g14; moral:local-maxxing = knowledge and wisdom per token). READ-ONLY on the repo except the ONE output file named below. No installs, no training, no paid APIs beyond your own model. Fetch the paper with curl/wget or pi web access; if a URL will not load, WebSearch its title/id and read the arXiv/HTML mirror — say exactly which document you read (URL + date). Tag every number MEASURED (quoted from the document, with section/table) or ESTIMATE. Never invent results. Context: everything the town runs must fit CPU + ordinary RAM (4-core ARM arm64 without i8mm, 23 GB; an 8 GB Intel box; an M3 Air 16 GB; one gpu-8g VRAM soon; Camber GPU 3 h/month). Owner's threads: bit-wise byte-neuron SNN where a bit FLIP is the impulse, coupled oscillators as flip-timing (digital Kuramoto), recurrent looped transformers (cross-token gated state feedback). The owner believes the oscillator/SNN/looped layer can supercharge each compute-saving trick in these papers — assess that FRANKLY, as a hypothesis with a falsifier, not as a given.

TASK read:{key} — digest {url} ({hint}). Extract every compute-saving technique: mechanism, MEASURED saving (memory/FLOPs/tok-s/cost, with the table it comes from), the hardware and model scale it assumes, what transfers to <=4B models on CPU (and what does not, and why), and one frank paragraph on the owner's oscillator/byte-neuron-SNN/looped bridge for THAT technique with a falsifier. Give 3-5 hypothesis seeds runnable on the town's CPUs. WRITE the full digest (all of the above, prose + tables, no length cap) to the file .agi/context/local-maxxing/papers/{key}.md (create it; that is your ONE allowed write), then return the structured JSON (set output_file to that path).

You are an ADVERSARIAL CRITIC of the digest of {url} written by the read stage (its structured return is in your context; the full digest is the file .agi/context/local-maxxing/papers/{key}.md — read it). Re-open the paper yourself and spot-check 3-5 quoted numbers and claims. Flag anything unsupported, hype-driven, or contradicting the source; name missing angles; judge the strongest and weakest hypothesis seed by knowledge-per-token on CPU; give a one-paragraph verdict on the owner's oscillator/SNN/looped bridge for this paper (supported / speculative / contradicted, with the reason). APPEND your critique as a '## CRITIQUE' section to the same file (your ONE allowed write), then return the structured JSON (output_file = that path). Default to skepticism.
